title: AIP Document (draft-prakash-aip-00 conformance + Wakir extensions)
description: JSON Schema for an Agent Identity Protocol document. Conforms to the structure described in draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.3 (required: aip, id, public_keys, name, delegation, protocols, document_signature, expires; identifiers per section 2.2). Adds Wakir-scoped optional extensions (verification_methods, service_endpoints, biscuit_root_pubkey) that do not break a strict AIP parser when stripped. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

id.description: AIP identifier. DNS-based aip:web:<domain>/<path> or self-certifying aip:key:ed25519:<multibase>. did:web is accepted as a Wakir cross-compat alias.

name.description: Human-readable agent name. Per Wakir Brand-Guide §9 use role-strings, never clear personal names.

public_keys.description: Array of public-key entries with validity windows (draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.3 'public_keys').

kid.description: Key identifier, stable inside this document.

alg.description: Signing algorithm. Wakir Phase 1a two-curve stack: Ed25519 (default for Biscuit / AIP signatures) and secp256k1 (BIP32 derivation root).

key_hex.description: Lowercase hex public key. Length is algorithm-specific (Ed25519=64 hex, secp256k1 compressed=66 hex).

delegation.description: Delegation preferences (draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.3 'delegation'). Constrains who may attenuate tokens issued by this identity.

mode.description: AIP delegation mode. 'compact' = JWT/EdDSA tokens only; 'chained' = Biscuit attenuation tokens only; 'both' = either accepted (draft-prakash-aip-00 sections 3.1/3.2).

protocols.description: Supported protocol bindings (draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.3 'protocols'). Wakir frames advertise 'wirelang/0.1' here.

document_signature.description: Self-signature over the JCS-canonicalised document (draft-prakash-aip-00 section 2.3 'document_signature'). Verification per RFC 8785 + RFC 8032 (Ed25519).

kid.description: kid of the signing public key inside public_keys.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, lowercase hex, 64 bytes (128 hex chars).

verification_methods.description: Wakir-scoped optional extension (DID-document-style verification methods). Not part of the strict AIP draft; ignored by AIP-only verifiers.

service_endpoints.description: Wakir-scoped optional extension. Service endpoints in DID-document style (id, type, serviceEndpoint URI).

biscuit_root_pubkey.description: Wakir-scoped optional extension. Lowercase-hex Ed25519 public key (64 hex chars) used to verify Biscuit authority-block signatures issued by this identity. When present, capability tokens referencing this AIP document via aip_document_ref MUST verify authority_block.signature against this key. When absent, verifiers fall back to public_keys with purpose='biscuit-root'.
